game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform glyph tablets.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform glyph tablets. Each round, ghost knights strike the glyph door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the glyph door from ghost knights in Broken Colonnade: keep the lab_output meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lab_output drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Broken Colonnade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while lab_output > 0.
